title: Pars II opens: Roman absolute faith is Spirit-moved assent to all God has revealed
source_text: I. Fides absolute spectata, secundum Doctores Ecclesiae Romanae, non aliud est quam assensus, Spiritu Sancto movente & inspirante, adhibitus omnibus iis quae sunt hominibus a Deo revelata; idque propter Dei revelantis veritatem & authoritatem.
pass_a_gloss: Faith absolutely considered, according to the Doctors of the Roman Church, is nothing other than assent, the Holy Spirit moving and inspiring, applied to all those things which have been revealed by God to men; and that on account of the truth and authority of the revealing God.
pass_b_english: Pars II opens the Roman comparison: for Rome's doctors, faith taken absolutely is Spirit-moved and Spirit-inspired assent to everything God has revealed to human beings.
The motive of that assent is the truth and authority of God who reveals.

lemmas.gloss: assent, the Holy Spirit moving and inspiring
on account of the truth and authority of the revealing God

rejected: faith as fiducia of remitted sins
